# ZAFFERANO & CO. LLC

> > Purveyor of authentic Italian artisan products, Venetian hand-painted crystal glassware, and hands-on pasta making classes with Chef Gianluca Deiana in New York City.

ZAFFERANO & CO. LLC specializes in premium Italian imports including Venetian crystal barware and tableware, artisan foods from regions across Italy (Puglia, Marche, Sardinia, Modena), and culinary experiences focused on Roman cuisine traditions. The company offers hands-on pasta making workshops teaching authentic recipes like Carbonara, Gricia, and Amatriciana with Chef Gianluca Deiana at Avenues The World School in NYC.

## Key Topics

- Venetian crystal glassware
- Hand-painted Italian barware
- Roman cuisine (Carbonara, Gricia, Amatriciana)
- Fresh pasta making workshops
- Chef Gianluca Deiana
- Artisan Italian foods
- Pecorino Romano
- Filotea pasta
- Extra virgin olive oil
- Italian culinary traditions
- NYC cooking classes
- Authentic Italian imports
- Tree of Life collection
- Type 00 flour
